cs.t: I liked the MS Ergo but, due to an office change, needed a wireless keyboard. I switched to the Logitech wireless keyboard and have absolutely hated it. The keys are too small and I make so many mistakes while coding, and that's after a year with it. Whatever you buy, check the size against the MSFT keyboard so that you don't do what I did: get stuck with a keyboard that's too small for you.

I have the wired Microsoft keyboard and it is fabulous. I switched to the wireless Logitech keyboard and it is terrible for productivity. It's like those Dell/HP keyboards where the keys are smaller and crammed closer together. It also doesn't have much of a curve to it. I would not buy it again nor would I recommend it, but the Microsoft keyboard is a definite winner.
cs.th: Ask HN: What ergonomic keyboard/mouse do you recommend?
